title: Add Command Palette
content: Build command palette/launcher (Cmd+K style). Modal overlay: fixed inset-0, centered content, dark backdrop. Search input: large, autofocused, with Search icon and keyboard shortcut hint. Results list: grouped by category with headers, icon + label + optional shortcut for each item. Keyboard navigation: arrow keys to navigate, Enter to execute, Escape to close. Search: filter all commands in real-time, fuzzy matching if possible. Recent/frequent commands section at top. Categories: Navigation, Actions, Settings, Help. Highlight matching text in results. Loading state for async searches. Empty state with suggestions. Animation: scale from 95% with opacity. Track usage for smart sorting. Register global keyboard shortcut with useEffect. Proper focus management and accessibility.

variants.advanced: Build command palette/launcher (Cmd+K style) with search, categories, and full keyboard control. Trigger: global keyboard shortcut (Cmd+K or Ctrl+K) via useEffect with keydown listener on document, check metaKey/ctrlKey + key === "k", prevent default. Modal structure: fixed inset-0 z-50, backdrop bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm, centered dialog max-w-xl w-full max-h-[60vh]. Dialog styling: bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col. Search header: p-4 border-b, input with pl-10 for Search icon, text-lg, autofocus, placeholder "Search commands...". Keyboard hint: absolute right-4 text-sm text-gray-400 "⌘K" badge. Results container: flex-1 overflow-y-auto py-2. Category groups: px-2, group header (text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase px-2 py-2). Result items: px-2 py-2.5 rounded-lg mx-2 cursor-pointer, flex items-center gap-3, icon (w-5 h-5 text-gray-400), label, optional keyboard shortcut (ml-auto text-xs bg-gray-100 px-1.5 rounded). Active/selected item: bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 (or bg-gray-100). Keyboard navigation: state for selectedIndex, ArrowDown/Up moves selection (wrap around), Enter executes selected command and closes, Escape closes. Search filtering: filter commands by label matching input, fuzzy matching with highlighting (bold matched chars), debounced for performance. Categories: Recent (last 5 used), Navigation (pages/routes), Actions (create, delete, etc.), Settings, Help. Empty state: "No results for [query]" with suggestions. Loading state: spinner for async searches (e.g., searching users/content). Track usage: store recent commands in localStorage, increment usage count for smart sorting. Animation: dialog scale-95 opacity-0 to scale-100 opacity-100. ACCESSIBILITY: role="dialog" aria-modal, combobox pattern (role="combobox" on input, role="listbox" on results, role="option" on items), aria-activedescendant for selected item. Focus trap: focus stays in palette. Close: Escape, backdrop click, or command execution.
